none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Mikhail Rudomanov, Ivan Fomin, Alexander V. Gasnikov, and Fedor S. Stonyakin. [Descending Everest with First-Order Oracles: Oracle Complexity of Convex Optimization under $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.21461v1). 2026 (preprint v1, 15 October). Complexity: $1+N=\Omega\!\left(1+\sqrt{L_0R^2/\varepsilon}+L_1R/\sqrt{\log(2+L_1R)}\right)$ necessary exact value-and-gradient oracle calls for arbitrary deterministic methods achieving $f(\hat x)-f^*\le\varepsilon$, in the worst case over Euclidean dimensions; $L_0,L_1,R>0$ and $\varepsilon\le L_0R^2$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a convex function f: ℝ^d → ℝ, with a global minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle returns ∇f(x) at arbitrary query points. Every history and seed must yield the exact gradient; function values are not returned. Algorithms may be randomized and have unrestricted query and output rules.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient map is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally. Here L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0; no global constant bound on the Hessian is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean ℝ^d, with d ≥ ⌈17592186044416(1 + L1R + √(L0R²/ε))^5⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d, L0, L1, x0, R, ε are public; the objective is hidden. R > 0 and 0 < ε ≤ L0R²/16. A minimizer lies within distance R of x0, without a separately supplied initial objective-gap bound.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return an arbitrary point xhat ∈ ℝ^d with integrable objective gap f(xhat) − f(xstar), where xstar is a global minimizer, and expected gap at most ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The requirement is E[f(xhat) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε under the execution law, allowing algorithm randomization. It is not an almost-sure accuracy requirement.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex exact-gradient optimization with gradient-dependent curvature and an explicit parameter-dependent high-dimensional regime.
